profile.name: Tapas Barman

profile.summary: AI Engineer and Python Developer specializing in LLM evaluation & safety benchmarking (DeepEval, Ragas, GEval rubrics), autonomous agentic AI workflows (LangGraph), and distributed streaming architectures (Apache Kafka, PyFlink).

highlights: Implemented automated retraining, drift monitoring, and CI/CD via MLflow, DVC, Evidently, and Jenkins.

projects.name: Kalanjiyam Digital Preservation Platform
projects.description: Platform for digital preservation and archiving of Siddha literature across 25 Indian languages through OCR-based text digitization and proofreading.
highlights: Replaced Tesseract with GPU-based EasyOCR, achieving a 3x speedup and 18% error reduction.
Built table detection and reconstruction using YOLO + Transformers, improving accuracy by 22%.

projects.name: LLM Mathematical Reasoning & Alignment
projects.description: Reviewed and corrected LLM-generated mathematical outputs using expert human reasoning.
highlights: Improved model responses by identifying reasoning errors, mathematical inaccuracies, and inconsistencies.
Provided corrected solutions and high-quality expert feedback for model alignment.

projects.name: Route Pilot — Autonomous Browser Agent
projects.description: Hybrid Planner–Actor–Evaluator autonomous browser agent (Playwright) for bus search and booking via Telegram bot.
metrics_and_impact: Built hybrid Planner–Actor–Evaluator browser agent using Playwright and LangGraph for autonomous bus search and booking.
Validated agent resilience via DeepEval across 78 golden tests achieving a 98%+ pass rate.
Cut token cost by 98.9% (reducing from 45,000 to 405 tokens per query).
projects.evaluation_and_safety: DeepEval evaluation across 78 golden test scenarios, browser execution timeout safeguards, and 98.9% prompt token optimization.

projects.name: RAG Evaluation Suite
projects.description: Two-stage RAG pipeline with dense vector indexing and cross-encoder reranking, governed by a continuous DeepEval regression evaluation suite.
metrics_and_impact: Built two-stage RAG pipeline combining ChromaDB vector search with MS-MARCO reranker for ultra-precise factual retrieval.
Engineered a DeepEval regression suite benchmarking Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, and Contextual Precision/Recall.
Achieved 100% guardrail pass rate at an ultra-low inference cost of .00018 per query.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Continuous DeepEval regression testing for Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision/Recall, and 100% safety guardrail compliance.

projects.name: LLM Fine-Tuning: Customer Support Agent
projects.description: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (4-bit QLoRA) of Mistral-7B-Instruct on customer support dialogue datasets with Unsloth optimization.
metrics_and_impact: Fine-tuned Mistral-7B-Instruct on 27,000 samples via 4-bit QLoRA with Unsloth acceleration.
Reduced GPU VRAM requirements by 70% and achieved a 5x training speedup.
Applied sequence packing, response-only loss masking, and NEFTune noise regularization for optimal conversational generalization.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Response-only loss masking to prevent training on user prompts, NEFTune regularization against overfitting, and loss convergence validation.

projects.name: Visa Approval Prediction — End-to-End MLOps Pipeline
projects.description: Production-grade MLOps pipeline for US visa approval forecasting with automated model training, validation, and containerized cloud deployment.
metrics_and_impact: Engineered end-to-end MLOps pipeline automating data ingestion from MongoDB Atlas, feature engineering, and model selection.
Packaged inference API with FastAPI and Docker for reproducible cloud execution.
Configured automated CI/CD deployment on AWS EC2 and AWS ECR via GitHub Actions.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Automated data drift checks, model performance gating before container registry push, and AWS IAM least-privilege security.

projects.name: Production MLOps Platform & Model Governance
projects.description: Enterprise-grade automated MLOps pipeline featuring model validation quality gates and automated retraining.
metrics_and_impact: Automated continuous data and model drift evaluation using Evidently AI with automated retraining triggers.
Embedded DevSecOps safety gates in Jenkins: SonarQube SAST, Trivy container CVE vulnerability scanning, and Gitleaks secret detection.
Champion-challenger model validation gating before production registry promotion.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Evidently AI drift monitoring, SonarQube SAST, Trivy container CVE scans, Gitleaks secrets detection.

projects.name: AI Trend Monitoring System
projects.description: Autonomous multi-step LangGraph agent pipeline tracking real-time AI developments with continuous evaluation.
metrics_and_impact: Ingests posts from Twitter and Reddit, performing sentiment analysis and safety filtering using DistilBERT.
Enriches extracted signals with real-time web intelligence using Tavily search API.
Uses DeepEval for evaluating summary faithfulness, context relevance, and hallucination prevention.
Monitored end-to-end via LangSmith tracing for reasoning graph observability and anomaly detection.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: DeepEval metric evaluation (faithfulness, hallucination rate, answer relevancy), LangSmith tracing for agent execution observability.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Medical AI Platform
projects.description: Production-grade multi-agent clinical RAG system with automated medical safety guardrails and evaluation.
metrics_and_impact: Orchestrated specialized agents for local document retrieval, PubMed research, and web verification.
Implemented cross-encoder reranking to ensure precise context retrieval without clinical hallucinations.
Integrated Ragas evaluation framework to track faithfulness, answer correctness, and context recall.
Enforced multi-tier safety guardrails: automated medical disclaimers, PII scrubbing, and clinical scope deflection.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Ragas evaluation (faithfulness, context recall, correctness), PII scrubbing, clinical safety disclaimer enforcement, cross-encoder reranking.

projects.name: LLM Safety Guardrails & Red-Teaming Suite
projects.description: Automated red-teaming and safety benchmarking suite designed to stress-test production LLM applications against adversarial vulnerabilities.
metrics_and_impact: Evaluates zero PII leakage under prompt extraction attacks and adversarial jailbreaks.
Enforces strict domain scope deflection with golden test suites and G-Eval alignment rubrics.
Benchmarks toxicity resilience and professional composure under hostile prompting using DeepEval metrics.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: PII leakage prevention, adversarial jailbreak defense, toxicity resilience scoring, GEval rubric evaluation.

projects.name: Real-Time Meteorological Streaming Engine
projects.description: Real-time data engineering and distributed stream-processing pipeline ingesting meteorological and radiosonde telemetry.
metrics_and_impact: Built Kafka producers to parse, merge, and stream atmospheric and flight data as real-time events.
Implemented PyFlink stream-processing jobs with keyed streams, event-time watermarking, and sliding/tumbling windows.
Containerized Kafka, Zookeeper, and Flink JobManager/TaskManager using Docker Compose for reproducible local deployment.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Event-time watermarking for out-of-order data resilience, schema validation on streaming events, and fault-tolerant stateful recovery across Flink clusters.

projects.name: Doodle.ai — AI-Powered Drawing Recognition Game
projects.description: Real-time interactive AI vision application comparing local and cloud-based multimodal models on user sketches.
metrics_and_impact: Built an interactive drawing canvas with low-latency auto-guess inference and multimodal feedback.
Engineered a multi-provider backend comparing local edge models (Ollama) with cloud vision APIs (Gemini, Groq LLaMA-Vision).
Implemented Challenge and Sandbox modes with automated rate-limit handling and session controls.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Multi-provider model latency vs. accuracy benchmarking, rate-limit safety fallbacks, and canvas input sanitization.

projects.name: Lumina Focus — Calm Tech Productivity Workspace
projects.description: Desktop productivity and focus workspace combining customizable Pomodoro timer with a distraction-shield workflow, packaged for Windows.
metrics_and_impact: Built customizable Pomodoro intervals (15–90 min) with task management and calendar scheduling.
Developed a multi-website focus hub with whitelisted productivity tools and a distraction shield.
Created productivity analytics tracking daily goals, focus hours, and 7-day category trends.
Packaged as native Windows desktop application using Electron with MSIX/APPX deployment support.
projects.evaluation_and_safety: Whitelisted distraction-shield workflow preventing attention drift, client-side data privacy with zero external tracking, and offline state persistence.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What roles is Tapas targeting?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Tapas is targeting AI Engineer, LLM Evaluation & Safety Engineer, and Python Developer positions.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What is Tapas' strongest skill set?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: His strongest domain is bridging the gap between rigorous LLM evaluation & safety (benchmarking faithfulness, hallucination, and guardrails via DeepEval and Ragas), stateful agentic workflows (LangGraph), and distributed Python systems (Apache Kafka, PyFlink).

frequently_asked_questions.question: Does Tapas have experience with LLM evaluation?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes. He has hands-on experience using both Ragas and DeepEval to quantitatively benchmark faithfulness, context precision, answer relevance, hallucination rate, and toxicity resilience, along with LangSmith for agent execution tracing.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can Tapas work with cloud services and containerization?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes. He works extensively with Docker and AWS services including EC2, S3, ECR, IAM, RDS, and Lambda, backed by automated CI/CD using GitHub Actions.
